title: Flo Balogun: "Outside noise" gave teammates "a bit of nerves" vs. Belgium

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Flo Balogun: "Outside noise" gave teammates "a bit of nerves" vs. Belgium
sources.description: It was obvious to anyone watching last Monday night's World Cup Round of 16 game between the U.S. and Belgium that the Folarin Balogun red-card suspension controversy helped one team — and hurt the other.
